BiblicalUsage: These are the lawyers and judges of Nebuchadnezzar's court. The king sends to gather them with the princes, governors, captains and treasurers for the dedication of his golden image, and they stand before it in their ranks.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the list is meant to be read whole: every arm of the empire is summoned to bow, and the three young men who will not bow stand out precisely because the court is so complete.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
